question_hint: how do I create an account
answer_facts: sign up in the CareBridge app with email and password or with Google
new accounts are patient accounts

question_hint: can I sign in with Google
answer_facts: you can sign in with your Google account
use the Sign in with Google button on the login page

question_hint: I cannot sign in to my account
answer_facts: contact reception at +880 1711-000000
reception is open Saturday to Thursday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM

question_hint: how do I update my profile details
answer_facts: open My Profile in the app
you can update details such as phone, address, allergies, and emergency contact

question_hint: who can see my medical records
answer_facts: patients see only their own appointments, prescriptions, and bills
doctors see the records of their own patients
reception staff can see all records to run the clinic

question_hint: can my family share one account
answer_facts: each person needs their own account
family members cannot share one account

question_hint: how are doctor and receptionist roles assigned
answer_facts: new sign-ups are patient accounts
doctor and receptionist roles are assigned by reception

question_hint: how do I delete my account
answer_facts: contact reception to delete your account
the reception phone is +880 1711-000000

question_hint: how do I book an appointment
answer_facts: open Book Appointment in the app
choose a doctor, a date, and a time slot
enter the reason for the visit
the booking starts with status requested

question_hint: what information do I need to book
answer_facts: the doctor
the date
the time slot
a short reason for the visit

question_hint: how do I choose the right doctor
answer_facts: the doctor list shows each doctor's specialization, fee, and working days
the assistant can suggest a specialization but it is not medical advice

question_hint: how do I choose a time slot
answer_facts: only the doctor's working days and listed slots can be booked
a slot that is already booked cannot be chosen

question_hint: what does requested status mean
answer_facts: requested means reception has not confirmed the booking yet
reception confirms it within the same working day

question_hint: how will I know my appointment is confirmed
answer_facts: the status changes to confirmed in My Appointments
you receive a reminder within the 24 hours before the visit

question_hint: how long does confirmation take
answer_facts: reception confirms requested bookings within the same working day
working days are Saturday to Thursday

question_hint: the slot I want is already booked
answer_facts: a booked slot cannot be chosen
you can join the waitlist for that doctor and day

question_hint: can I book an appointment for someone else
answer_facts: each patient books from their own account
family members need their own accounts

question_hint: do you accept walk-in patients
answer_facts: walk-ins are seen only if a slot is free
booking in the app is preferred

question_hint: what should I bring to my first visit
answer_facts: photo ID
previous prescriptions
recent test reports

question_hint: what happens if I arrive late
answer_facts: arriving more than 15 minutes late may require rescheduling

question_hint: how do I cancel an appointment
answer_facts: open My Appointments and cancel the appointment
you can cancel while the status is requested or confirmed

question_hint: which appointments can I cancel
answer_facts: only requested or confirmed appointments can be cancelled
completed appointments cannot be cancelled

question_hint: is there a cancellation fee
answer_facts: there is no cancellation fee

question_hint: how do I reschedule an appointment
answer_facts: open My Appointments and choose reschedule
pick a new future date on the doctor's working day and slot

question_hint: what are the rules for rescheduling
answer_facts: only requested or confirmed appointments can be rescheduled
the new date must be in the future
the new slot must be one of the doctor's slots on a working day

question_hint: can I change a completed appointment
answer_facts: completed appointments cannot be cancelled or rescheduled
book a new follow-up appointment instead

question_hint: what counts as a no-show
answer_facts: a confirmed appointment not completed 1 hour after its start time is flagged as a possible no-show

question_hint: what happens after I miss an appointment
answer_facts: reception reviews the possible no-show
reception may contact you to rebook

question_hint: what is the waitlist
answer_facts: the waitlist lets you wait for a full day or slot with a doctor
when a slot is freed the next patient on the waitlist gets an offer

question_hint: how do I join the waitlist
answer_facts: join the waitlist when the slot or day you want is full
you can have one open waitlist entry per doctor and day

question_hint: how will I know I got a waitlist offer
answer_facts: you get a notification under the bell icon
the offer also appears in My Appointments

question_hint: how long do I have to accept a waitlist offer
answer_facts: 120 minutes
accept the offer in My Appointments
the offer expires if not accepted in time
the slot then passes to the next patient on the waitlist

question_hint: my waitlist offer expired
answer_facts: an offer not accepted within 120 minutes expires
the slot passes to the next patient on the waitlist
you can join the waitlist again

question_hint: how do I leave the waitlist
answer_facts: you can leave the waitlist at any time from My Appointments

question_hint: will I get a reminder before my appointment
answer_facts: a reminder is sent within the 24 hours before a confirmed appointment
reminders appear under the bell icon in the app

question_hint: where do I see my notifications
answer_facts: notifications appear under the bell icon in the app

question_hint: I did not get a reminder
answer_facts: reminders are sent only for confirmed appointments
check that your booking status is confirmed

question_hint: do you send SMS reminders
answer_facts: the clinic does not send SMS reminders
reminders appear as in-app notifications under the bell icon

question_hint: will I be notified about waitlist offers
answer_facts: you get a notification when a waitlist slot is offered
you have 120 minutes to accept it

question_hint: where can I find my prescription
answer_facts: open My Prescriptions in the app

question_hint: when will my prescription appear
answer_facts: the doctor writes the prescription at the end of the consultation
it appears in My Prescriptions once the appointment is completed

question_hint: what does a prescription contain
answer_facts: the date
the doctor
the diagnosis
each medicine with dosage, frequency, and duration
the doctor's notes

question_hint: can one visit have more than one prescription
answer_facts: each appointment has one prescription

question_hint: how do I get a refill
answer_facts: book a follow-up appointment for a refill

question_hint: there is an error on my prescription
answer_facts: contact reception to report an error on a prescription

question_hint: can the AI assistant change my medicines
answer_facts: the assistant cannot change medicines
only your doctor can change a prescription

question_hint: I have side effects from my medicine
answer_facts: contact the clinic or your doctor about side effects
for emergencies call 999

question_hint: when is my bill created
answer_facts: reception creates the bill after your visit

question_hint: how do I pay my bill
answer_facts: pay at reception after the visit
payment methods are cash, card, or mobile banking

question_hint: which payment methods do you accept
answer_facts: cash
card
mobile banking
